release.releaseNotes:
Private update for Bob (Build 124 - Realistic Speedometer Instrument Cluster).
• Real Numeric Range Scale: Printed range values (0, 400, 800, 1200, 1600, 2000) with precision major/medium/minor tick divisions.
• Authentic 3D Sports Needle: Tapered blade with counterweight tail, 3D drop shadow, faceted spine, and illuminated pointer tip.
• Ambient Backlit Dial Lighting: Radial cockpit backlighting, brushed metallic bezel, and dynamic halo following needle sweep.
• Tachometer Redline Zone: 1600 to 2000 quota warned with crimson redline arc and red tick marks.
• Lower Digital Readout: Speedometer numbers centered in the lower open quadrant of the arc without needle obstruction.
